**Summary**: In USMF as of March 2, 2026, there are exactly 2 open sales orders:

| Sales ID | Customer | Order Date | Status |
|----------|----------|------------|--------|
| 724 | US-027 (Birch Company) | 2026-02-18 | Open order |
| 725 | US-004 (Cave Wholesales) | 2026-02-20 | Open order |

Both Birch Company and Cave Wholesales are tied with **1** open order each. Sales order 726 (Contoso Retail Detroit) is "Delivered" and not open. I reported the first open order — **724** (Birch Company).
